zh.title: 波音GOL行長費雷爾任拉美總裁九月四日上任
zh.summary: 波音GOL行長費雷爾任拉美總裁；GOL升費爾為新任行長
body: 波音公司於2026年8月13日宣，任巴西廉航空公司GOL Linhas Aéreas行長Celso Ferrer任拉丁美洲及加勒比地區總裁，自9月4日起生效。波音表示，費雷爾將「負強化波音在該地區的運、策略與局」，並支援整個拉美及加勒比地區的成長機會。
費雷爾在GOL任職超過20年，2004年以實生身分加入，歷任運長與規副總裁，過去四年任行長。根據GOL資料，他持有波音737-700、737-800新世代與737-8 Max機型照。波音全球總裁Brendan Nelson賞費雷爾有「越經、領導能力與專業知」，是應對該動態且重要地區機遇與戰的適任人選。
GOL同步宣，費雷爾將於8月31日任，由André Fehlauer接任行長，9月正式上任；現任運長Albert Perez將任總裁兼運長，持續監督日常運。費爾曾在GOL下Smiles忠度業務深八年，近期任巴西忠度公司Livelo行長，亦曾任職Citi與Credicard。佩雷斯2024年初加入GOL，具超過二十年航空經，曾任Avianca、JetSMART與Vueling高階主管。
費雷爾自2022年起領導GOL，主導公司重組與入Abra Group。Abra Group行長Adrian Neuhauser表示，費爾對GOL的度與佩雷斯的運背景將支援航空集團下一階段成長。
Abra Group下有Avianca、策略性投資Wamos Air、持有Sky Airline可權少數股權，自稱有約3萬名員工、運超過300架飛機，服務超過25個國家的145個目的地。
波音前拉美及加勒比地區總裁Landon Loomis已於2025年10月任波音中國總裁。

en.title: Boeing appoints GOL CEO Celso Ferrer as Latin America president effective September 4
en.summary: Boeing hires GOL CEO Ferrer as Latin America president; GOL promotes Fehlauer to CEO
body: Boeing announced on August 13, 2026 that it has recruited Celso Ferrer, chief executive of Brazilian low-cost carrier GOL Linhas Aéreas, as its new president for Latin America and the Caribbean, effective September 4, 2026. Boeing said Ferrer will be "responsible for strengthening Boeing's operations, strategy, and presence across the region" and supporting growth opportunities throughout Latin America and the Caribbean.

Ferrer has spent more than 20 years with GOL, joining as an intern in 2004 and serving as chief operating officer and vice president of planning before becoming CEO four years ago. According to GOL, he is a certified pilot for the Boeing 737-700, Boeing 737-800 Next Generation, and Boeing 737-8 Max aircraft. Boeing Global president Dr. Brendan Nelson AO praised Ferrer's "exceptional experience, leadership skills and expertise" as the right fit for the region's opportunities and challenges.

GOL simultaneously named André Fehlauer as its new chief executive after Ferrer agreed to leave for Boeing. Ferrer will step down on August 31, 2026, with Fehlauer taking over as CEO in September. Current chief operating officer Albert Perez will assume the expanded role of president and COO, continuing to oversee day-to-day operations as the carrier expands its domestic and international network.

Fehlauer returns to GOL after eight years with the company's Smiles loyalty business in Argentina and Brazil. He most recently served as CEO of Livelo, a Brazilian loyalty program, and previously held positions at Citi and Credicard. Perez joined GOL in early 2024 after more than two decades in aviation, including leadership roles at Avianca, JetSMART and Vueling.

Ferrer has led GOL since 2022 and oversaw a restructuring of the company and its integration with Abra Group. Abra Group CEO Adrian Neuhauser said Fehlauer's previous experience with GOL and Perez's operational background would support the airline's next phase of growth.

Abra Group also owns Avianca, holds a strategic investment in Wamos Air, and holds convertible debt representing a minority interest in Sky Airline. The group says it has about 30,000 employees and operates more than 300 aircraft serving more than 145 destinations in over 25 countries. The former Boeing president for Latin America and the Caribbean, Landon Loomis, started a new role as president of Boeing China in October 2025.
